unlisted_practices: Distilling a reinforcement learning insulin controller into fine-tuned LLMs that give plain-language explanations of dosing decisions
Formal safety verification of LLM-generated insulin dosing actions against hallucinations

screen.reason: The paper introduces a novel LLM-based controller (LLM-T1D) for closed-loop artificial pancreas systems and evaluates it on an FDA-approved simulation benchmark (UVA/Padova T1D simulator). It assesses model performance and explainability, but does not test a health system deployment practice or operational safeguard.
